stem: 哪些信托和公司服务提供商(TCSP)的特征可能使其容易受到金融犯罪的侵害？(选择三项.)

options.A: 他们可能会专门向罪犯推销自己
options.B: 提供代名董事可能会通过隐瞒真实所有权来增加匿名性
options.C: 在大多数司法管辖区,他们无需遵守反洗钱法规
options.D: 向境外中介机构出售现成的公司
options.E: 与客户面对面接触极少,尤其是在离岸安排的情况下

stem_en: Which characteristics of trust and company service providers (TCSPs) can potentially make them vulnerable to financial crime? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: They may market themselves specifically to criminals
options_en.B: Offering nominee directors may increase anonymity by concealing true ownership
options_en.C: They do not have to comply with AML regulations in most jurisdictions
options_en.D: Selling ready-made, off-the-shelf companies to offshore intermediaries
options_en.E: Having minimal face-to-face contact with customers, particularly in offshore arrangements
